FAQs

What should we bring?

Come dressed for the weather and ready to get muddy knees! No rugby kit is needed, but if your child already has boots, please feel free to use them.

Is there a snack break?

Yes, we take a snack and drink break midway through every session. Please come prepared with a snack and a drink for your child.

How long are the sessions?

Sessions run for approximately one hour, on Saturday mornings in term time.

Do parents need to stay?

We ask that parents and guardians stay and watch. We love having you there!

Where do we meet?

On Tooting Common, London SW17, opposite the Rose and Crown Pub. Use the map above to find us.

What happens after the free taster?

If your child would like to join us for the rest of the term, we will be in touch with payment details. There is absolutely no obligation and no pressure. We just hope they have a brilliant time!

I have another question

Please don't hesitate to get in touch. We are always happy to hear from you. You'll find our emails in the contact section.

See you on the pitch!
